source_cause: pandapower ADict.__deepcopy__ delegates ordinary DataFrame values to copy.deepcopy.
DataFrame.__deepcopy__ delegates to copy(deep=True); BlockManager applies Block.copy, which calls values.copy.
BaseMaskedArray.copy copies only _data and _mask and returns _simple_new(data,mask). _simple_new constructs a new array with those two attributes; it does not copy the old cached dtype object/state.
NumericArray.dtype is cached and resolves the new array dtype through IntegerDtype._get_dtype_mapping()/NUMPY_INT_TO_DTYPE, rather than inheriting the old archived dtype cache.

BaseMaskedDtype.numpy_dtype derives np.dtype(self.type); kind derives self.numpy_dtype.kind. Both getters are cache_readonly. Thus cached object state can differ while exact array data/masks and dtype meaning remain unchanged.
